companies.name: Dawn
companies.description: Dawn is building VIM (Virtual Intelligent Mentor), a lightweight AR glasses paired with intelligent software designed for frontline manufacturing workers. VIM combines AI with traditional shop-floor resources to deliver workers instant and hands-free access to the knowledge they need. By closing the skill gap, reducing downtime, and modernizing training, Dawn helps manufacturers boost productivity and preserve expertise.

companies.name: ReGlove
companies.description: ReGlove is building an AI-powered rehabilitation glove designed to help stroke survivors regain motor control and independence in their daily lives. By supporting natural grasping motions, ReGlove empowers patients to perform everyday activities—like holding a cup of coffee or buttoning a shirt—while also serving as a tool for continuous rehabilitation beyond the clinic. Their mission is to make recovery more accessible, effective, and motivating for millions of people living with the long-term effects of stroke.

companies.name: Ludus
companies.description: Ludus eliminates manual flashcard creation for language students. Open any word in our pre-loaded dictionaries, click save, and it’s automatically added to your personalized study deck.

companies.name: Hearify
companies.description: Hearify is an application that eases the process of aural rehabilitation for members of the hard-of-hearing community, saving countless hours of audiologist training by allowing one to practice from the comfort of their own home. Built with features to mimic all aspects of auditory training, from matched pair sets to sound and word recognition, the app also implements AI analytics and features to complement the work of an audiologist. This application saves time and revolutionizes the process of aural rehabilitation present today.

companies.name: Wagoo
companies.description: Wagoo is developing a voice-first productivity assistant that answers questions and completes tasks. All with just a push of a button, with hundreds of integrations. Schedule meetings, respond to emails, search the web, plan your day, have conversations, and so much more.

companies.name: Vitband
companies.description: Vitband is the first wearable device that tracks muscles in real time. Powered by our patent-pending sEMG technology, it helps athletes optimize training load and find personalized sweet spots for peak performance. By tracking muscle strength, activation, and fatigue in real time, it tells athletes exactly when to push, when to recover, and how to avoid injury. Backed by UC Berkeley and Stanford University, and trusted by Olympians, Vitband transforms raw muscle signals into actionable insights for athletes to reach their full potential.

companies.name: PollenPal
companies.description: PollenPal is an AI-powered monitoring system designed for beekeepers, using beehive-mounted devices with computer vision and sensors to detect threats like varroa mites and invasive bee species. Built for easy deployment, it delivers real-time alerts and offers actionable insights, helping operations save on replacement costs while improving margins through efficient management. With solutions for both hobbyists and large farms, PollenPal bridges tech gaps in an aging industry facing billions in annual losses.

companies.name: Manglovo Health
companies.description: Manglovo Health is a biotech startup advancing next-generation therapeutics and technologies in reproductive health. Our lead asset is a uterine-selective estrogen receptor antagonist, being developed as a once-weekly oral contraceptive without hormones.

companies.name: Created by
companies.description: Created by chefs for chefs, ROA is an AI-powered SaaS platform that revolutionizes restaurant operations by addressing food waste, high labor turnover, and narrow margins. Our kitchen-native solution—combining semantic recipe management, invoice-based inventory tracking, and POS-aware demand forecasting—empowers chefs to streamline kitchen workflows and optimise resource allocation.

companies.name: Silo
companies.description: Silo is an automated portfolio generator tailored for engineers. Users upload their work artifacts—such as code repositories, PDFs, and CAD diagrams—and Silo's in-house LLM pipeline creates a professional portfolio hosted on a customizable URL.

companies.name: Saturn
companies.description: Saturn is like a mutual fund for the blockchain being built on Solana. By minting Saturn tokens, which each represent an actively managed portfolio through fundamental and eventually quantitative management, we unify the best of the blockchain ecosystem into a single token, giving users diversified exposure to digital asset innovation. Unlike traditional funds, on-chain investments offer full transparency, instant liquidity, and access to high-growth sectors like DeFi and Web3. Saturn provides a seamless way for everyone to participate in cutting-edge blockchain projects, making investing in crypto simpler, more efficient, and potentially more rewarding.

companies.name: SWERV
companies.description: SWERV is developing a consumer ventilation product made to improve human health and comfort. It's a small box you place in your window that efficiently brings in filtered fresh air from outside at the perfect temperature and humidity year round.

companies.name: Sante Health
companies.description: Sante Health is a startup leveraging AI to help governments, health insurers, and hospitals manage infectious disease outbreaks. Our machine learning model uses epidemiological, climate, and urban spatial data to identify high-risk areas and predict outbreaks before they happen, enabling proactive health interventions to protect communities. We have already developed our first MVP for dengue prediction in Brazil and are now advancing scalable, data-driven solutions to improve healthcare resource allocation.
